curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How do image juxtapositions and Philip Glass’s music shape this wordless look at technology’s toll?
curatedMovie.description: Across locations in the United States, this wordless visual tone poem considers modern technology’s toll on people and the earth.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Immersive, heavy, and deeply thoughtful, moving with deliberate patience best experienced in solitary, undistracted viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Stripped of spoken narration, the film builds its argument entirely through striking visual juxtapositions driven by an exceptional, hypnotic score from Philip Glass.
